/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('orf.annot.q1.fa').read_text().splitlines()[1].strip()
codons={'UUU','UUC'}; stops={'UAA','UAG','UGA'}
best=[]
for frame in range(3):
    i=frame
    orfs=[]
    while i+2 < len(s):
        if s[i:i+3]=='AUG':
            j=i+3
            while j+2<len(s) and s[j:j+3] not in stops:
                j+=3
            if j+2<len(s):
                l=(j-i)//3
                orfs.append((l,i,j))
        i+=3
    print('frame',frame,orfs)
    best += orfs
best.sort(reverse=True)
print('longest',best[0])
# translate longest
_,i,j=best[0]
code={
'GCU':'A','GCC':'A','GCA':'A','GCG':'A','CGU':'R','CGC':'R','CGA':'R','CGG':'R','AGA':'R','AGG':'R',
'AAU':'N','AAC':'N','GAU':'D','GAC':'D','UGU':'C','UGC':'C','CAA':'Q','CAG':'Q','GAA':'E','GAG':'E',
'GGU':'G','GGC':'G','GGA':'G','GGG':'G','CAU':'H','CAC':'H','AUU':'I','AUC':'I','AUA':'I',
'UUA':'L','UUG':'L','CUU':'L','CUC':'L','CUA':'L','CUG':'L','AAA':'K','AAG':'K','AUG':'M',
'UUU':'F','UUC':'F','CCU':'P','CCC':'P','CCA':'P','CCG':'P','UCU':'S','UCC':'S','UCA':'S','UCG':'S','AGU':'S','AGC':'S',
'ACU':'T','ACC':'T','ACA':'T','ACG':'T','UGG':'W','UAU':'Y','UAC':'Y','GUU':'V','GUC':'V','GUA':'V','GUG':'V'}
prot=''.join(code.get(s[k:k+3],'X') for k in range(i,j,3))
print(prot)
print(len(prot),i,j)
